# ViraStack AI v1 (archived)

> Archived guide for `@virastack/ai` v1.3. v1 is no longer maintained. For new projects use v2: [llms.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt). To move an existing v1 project, see [Upgrade to v2](https://virastack.com/ai/docs/upgrade).

Install v1 explicitly: `npx @virastack/ai@1 init`. Detects Next.js vs TanStack Start from `package.json` and writes only the relevant rules.

For the v1 CLI and written files inline, prefer [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/v1/llms-full.txt).

## Docs & pages

- [v1 docs (archive)](https://virastack.com/ai/docs/v1): Install, flags, rules and files for v1
- [Current docs (v2)](https://virastack.com/ai/docs): Latest documentation
- [Upgrade to v2](https://virastack.com/ai/docs/upgrade): What changes and how to migrate
- [llms-full.txt](https://virastack.com/ai/v1/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable v1 guide
- [npm `@virastack/ai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@virastack/ai): Package registry
- [GitHub](https://github.com/virastack/ai): Source and rule templates

## What v1 writes

- `AGENTS.md`: universal agent operating guide
- `CLAUDE.md`: Claude Code entry (`@AGENTS.md`)
- `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`: scoped Cursor rules
- `docs/`: architecture guide and project memory templates

## Related

- [ViraStack llms.txt](https://virastack.com/llms.txt): Ecosystem map
- [AI v2](https://virastack.com/ai/llms.txt): Current AI guide
- [Start](https://virastack.com/start/llms.txt): Scaffolds that pre-install AI
